d: Deep crimson, shoulder-length hair is styled with voluminous waves and sweeping bangs that partially cover the forehead. Sharp, glowing crimson eyes with a cunning expression are set in a youthful, mature face. A slender build is paired with a dark, ornate outfit featuring a black high-collar neckpiece adorned with silver pearls and a central gemstone. Pointed elf ears protrude from the sides of the head.
